desc: Gujarat has the longest coastline in India at ~1,600 km. Includes Gulf of Kutch, Gulf of Khambhat. Major ports: Kandla, Mundra, Jamnagar. Rich in mangroves, coral reefs. Marine National Park in Gulf of Kutch.
fact: 1,600 km (longest) · Gulf of Kutch & Khambhat · Kandla, Mundra ports · Marine NP

desc: 1,076 km coastline along the Bay of Bengal and Gulf of Mannar. Major ports: Chennai, Tuticorin, Ennore. Marina Beach (13 km, second longest urban beach). Palk Bay, Gulf of Mannar Marine NP.
fact: 1,076 km · Bay of Bengal · Chennai, Tuticorin · Marina Beach · Gulf of Mannar

desc: 974 km coastline along Bay of Bengal. Major ports: Visakhapatnam (deepest port), Kakinada, Gangavaram. Krishna and Godavari deltas. Rich mangrove forests (Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary).
fact: 974 km · Visakhapatnam port · Godavari-Krishna deltas · Coringa mangroves

desc: 720 km Konkan coastline along Arabian Sea. Major ports: Mumbai (JNPT), Nhava Sheva. Includes Mumbai, Pune, Ratnagiri. Rocky coastline with numerous creeks and estuaries. Important fishing grounds.
fact: 720 km · Konkan coast · Mumbai, JNPT ports · Rocky coastline · Fishing

desc: 480 km coastline along Bay of Bengal. Major ports: Paradip, Dhamra, Gopalpur. Chilika Lake (largest brackish water lagoon). Olive Ridley turtle nesting at Gahirmatha. Cyclone-prone (Phailin, Fani).
fact: 480 km · Paradip port · Chilika Lake · Olive Ridley turtles · Cyclone prone

desc: 580 km Malabar coast along Arabian Sea. Backwaters (Kerala backwaters, Vembanad Lake). Major ports: Kochi, Vizhinjam. Beaches: Kovalam, Varkala. Coconut palm fringed. Fishing and tourism hub.
fact: 580 km · Malabar coast · Kochi port · Backwaters · Beaches · Coconut

desc: Shortest coastline among mainland states. Sundarbans delta (World's largest mangrove forest). Major port: Kolkata (Haldia). Home to Royal Bengal Tiger. UNESCO World Heritage. Erosion and rising sea levels threaten.
fact: 157 km (shortest mainland) · Sundarbans delta · Kolkata port · Royal Bengal Tiger

desc: 160 km coastline along Arabian Sea. Famous beaches: Baga, Calangute, Anjuna. Mormugao port. Tourism-driven economy. Sand dunes, sea cliffs, estuaries. Mandovi and Zuari rivers.
fact: 160 km · Famous beaches (Baga, Calangute) · Mormugao port · Tourism · Mandovi River

desc: 320 km coastline. Major ports: Mangalore (New Mangalore Port), Karwar. Beaches: Gokarna, Murudeshwar, Udupi. Rocky coast with cliffs. Netravati and Sharavati rivers.
fact: 320 km · Mangalore port · Karwar · Gokarna, Murudeshwar beaches · Rocky coast

desc: 45 km coastline including Puducherry, Karaikal, Yanam regions. Promenade Beach. French colonial heritage. Fishing communities. Limited beach tourism.
fact: 45 km · Puducherry, Karaikal, Yanam · Promenade Beach · French heritage · Fishing

desc: ~30 km coastline. Daman on Gujarat coast, Diu island. Beaches: Devka, Jampore, Nagoa, Ghoghola. Portuguese colonial heritage. Forts and churches along the coast.
fact: 30 km · Daman & Diu · Devka, Nagoa beaches · Portuguese heritage · Fishing

desc: ~1,962 km coastline across 572 islands. Andaman Sea and Bay of Bengal. Radhanagar Beach (best in Asia). Coral reefs, mangroves. Cellular Jail. Indigenous tribes. Rich biodiversity.
fact: 1,962 km · 572 islands · Radhanagar Beach · Coral reefs · Cellular Jail · Tribes

desc: ~132 km coastline across 36 coral islands. Lagoons, coral atolls, white sand beaches. Agatti, Bangaram, Kavaratti. Marine life: sea turtles, manta rays. Protected reefs. Tourism restricted.
fact: 132 km · 36 coral islands · Lagoons & atolls · Agatti, Bangaram · Restricted tourism
